# Avsnitt 604 - Rapportfällorna

**Feed**: fill-or-kill  
**Published**: 2026-10-27  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This Fill or Kill episode (604) goes through the latest Nordic reports. Bone Support jumped about 30% on a strong report and an unusually large short-covering, while Volvo Cars, Intrum and Atlas Copco fell sharply. AI and data-center names such as ABB and Wärtsilä were sold off on doubts about the build-out, and the hosts say quality companies hit in sector sell-offs can be bought later. The macro discussion covers Lula's surprise win in Brazil hurting iGaming names, the US midterms, possible Ukraine peace trades, and oil. One host bought Logistea in the Rutger block sale and both own Kambi.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟠 BONEX — Bone Support | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Strong report, short interest down to about 5%, FDA decision pending. Host calls it a very fine company but did not buy after the 33% jump.

#### Reasoning

US growth is back on track and the short-selling overhang is mostly gone after a rare large short-covering. Valuation is back to a reasonable level and the FDA approval is a possible trigger. The host held off buying after the gap-up, so this is a watch, not a buy.

#### Sell Triggers

- FDA approval delayed or denied
- US growth slows
- short interest builds again

> *"fortfarande ett enormt fint bolag och nu har man ju liksom fått bort det här blanka stöket nu när det bara är 5% blankat"*

---

### ⛔ INTRUM — Intrum | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Shrinking business, heavy debt and refinancing within a year. Hosts call it a 'too hard bucket', only for intraday trading.

#### Reasoning

Collections business is shrinking, with high debt and refinancing risk. Hedge funds are building a negative story about the company, and the insider buys are too small to signal much. It could pay off if rates fall, but hosts say it is too complex to hold long-term as a private investor.

> *"att få ett grepp om långsiktigt känns väldigt svårt för en privatperson. Financial engineering. Too hard bucket."*

---

### 🟠 VOLCAR-B — Volvo Cars | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Fell 30% after a bad report. Insider buying and possible Geely buyout point to some value, but the sector needs 6-24 months to turn.

#### Reasoning

Host tried to buy around 10 SEK and sees some value plus a possible Geely buyout. However, the car sector is very messy, with Chinese competition and weaker brand loyalty, and needs 6-24 months to recover.

#### Sell Triggers

- further profit warnings
- Geely buyout loses the US licence

> *"Något form av värde finns det ju här i Volvo Cars i alla fall. Sen verkar det ju vara att man kommer behöva hålla ut i 6-24 månader."*

---

### 🟢 LOGI-B — Logistea | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Host bought in the Rutger block sale, which removed the overhang; may mark a bottom in property stocks.

#### Reasoning

The block sale removed a long-awaited overhang on the stock. The host made a good trade on it and suggests it may mark a bottom for property stocks if rates stop rising.

#### Sell Triggers

- long rates rise again

> *"fillen var Logistea köpte på den här Rutger blocket"*

---

### 🟠 KYIV — Kyivstar | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Trades at $13.30, cheap against peers. Could reach $20 on Ukraine peace headlines.

#### Reasoning

This Ukrainian telecom operator moves strongly on peace news, and peace talks are being discussed around the US midterms. It is cheap against peers. The host does not own it.

#### Sell Triggers

- peace talks collapse

> *"kommer det mycket headlines om att det är en fred på gång så tror jag att den här står i 20 dollar"*

---

### ⛔ SBB-B — SBB | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

The D-share buyback offer was voted down and a new meeting is called. Hosts call it messy and advise against preference shares.

#### Reasoning

The D-share buyback is a poker game between the company and D-share holders with an unclear outcome. Hosts say preference shares give the worst of both shares and bonds, and the situation is messy.

> *"Rörigt. Köp inte preferensaktier."*
